title: 7 nights ago
content: Dream seemed so important I felt it everywhere and couldn't even discuss until now. To summarize: There was some kind of ship collision in a US city bay that was being covered up by the govt. I just saw a scifi crash scene in a bay being hidden by US military battleships. Then I fly suddenly to a body of water that looked like south america and see large groups of people being loaded into a ship that flies in the sky and then goes underwater. They were being loaded execution style. It was a threat, not a happy thing. There was more but that was the main parts I recall. Don't worry too much tho, I don't think I was in the mallworld. I'm just sharing here in case mallworld ppl saw anything similar in case I was. But I can tell where I am by the colors. This dream had earth colors so idk. The next day, I woke up shaken and feeling traumatized which is odd I've experienced real trauma-why would this dream make me feel similar?
